title: Shared canonical field definitions
description: Fields appearing in more than one document schema are defined ONCE here and $ref'd. Defining them per-schema lets two definitions of the same canonical field drift apart, and no test catches it because each schema still validates on its own. See SPEC_01 and arch 0c.
$comment: DESCRIPTIONS ARE PROMPT TEXT. They are injected into the system prompt at corpus-build and inference time, so editing one forces a corpus rebuild and a new training cycle (arch 7). Write them as definitions with exclusions, never as lists of surface labels. FIRST DRAFT - requires insurance SME review before the first real corpus build.

insured_name.description: The party purchasing the insurance policy - the person or organisation whose risk is covered. Not the certificate holder, not the producer or agency, not an additional insured, not the carrier.

insured_address.description: The mailing or business address of the party purchasing the policy. Not the certificate holder's address and not the producer's address.

policy_number.description: The identifier assigned to the bound policy by the carrier. Not a quote number, binder number, submission number, or claim number. Preserve the carrier's formatting including any prefix or hyphens.

effective_date.description: The date coverage begins, as YYYY-MM-DD. Not the date the document was issued, printed, or signed.

expiration_date.description: The date coverage ends, as YYYY-MM-DD. Not a cancellation date and not a renewal date.

carrier.description: The insurance company bearing the risk and issuing the policy. Not the producer or agency that placed it, not the insured, and not the certificate holder.

producer.description: The broker or agency that placed the policy. Not the carrier that issued it and not the insured who bought it.

certificate_holder.description: The party to whom a certificate of insurance is issued as evidence that coverage exists. A third party with an interest in the coverage, not the party who purchased it.

additional_insured.description: Parties extended coverage under the named insured's policy. Distinct from the named insured, who is the party that purchased it.

total_premium.description: The total premium for the policy term, as a number without currency symbols or thousands separators. Not a per-coverage premium, deposit, instalment, or surcharge.
